name: SWEEP-S1v2 Identical eight
_design: Divergence test: 8 identical Haiku agents, same instruction and stats, on an 8-fold symmetric ring in an empty 15x15 world; a tree on every start point plus 6 more. Thinking costs ~2.5x default (~5.7 compute per decision); fruit 18 net. Question: do identical agents diverge into different strategies? | v2 fix (world only): S1v1 ran to r60 and all 8 starved (deaths r36-r60), with 0 messages, 0 skills and 0 meetings; roamers found ~1 fruit each (6 extra trees over 225 tiles, per-point observe) and went broke by r18-24, campers lasted to r47-60. Changes: map 15x15 -> 11x11 and ring (+-2,+-4)/(+-4,+-2) so every agent is exactly 4 steps from both ring neighbours (v1: 4 and 6); communication range 3 -> 4 (neighbours can hear from r1); vision 2 -> 3; trees 14 -> 20 (8 on starts + 12 random, about 1 per 6 tiles, so roaming can pay); starting compute 150 -> 250 (v1 agents were broke with 10-30 zombie rounds left). Thinking price (~5.7), absorption 0.3, fruit and persona unchanged.
